image_description: A male black grouse (blackcock) perched among dry, leafless branches against a pale, overcast sky. The bird displays glossy black plumage with visible iridescence on the neck, prominent red eyebrow combs, and a short dark beak. Its body is stocky, and it appears to be gripping the branches with feathered legs.
